omasnap on Omarchy

Short answer

To install omasnap on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add omasnap. It is a 1.1 MB download (2.4 MB installed), version 1.24.0-1, licensed MIT, OFL-1.1. Native Wayland screenshot and annotation overlay for Hyprland. Free and open source.

On this page Install Open and use Requirements Uninstall Package facts Questions

Install omasnap on Omarchy

Omasnap is a native screenshot and markup overlay for Hyprland on Wayland. Beyond capturing a region, window, or whole monitor, it lets you draw arrows, shapes, freehand lines, and text over the shot, blur or block out sensitive areas, run one-click OCR to pull text out of an image, and even stitch together scrolling captures of long pages. Finished screenshots can be pinned on top of your other windows or reopened later from a recent-captures shelf, with full undo history preserved even if the app crashes.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add omasnap
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 1.24.0-1:
    pacman -Qi omasnap

Open and use omasnap

omasnap is a desktop app. Press Super + Space to open the launcher and search for it. If it does not show up by name, list the desktop entries the package installed:

pacman -Ql omasnap | grep applications

omasnap requirements and compatibility

  • Wayland session with Hyprland (or a compositor offering equivalent window/monitor APIs)

Frequently asked questions

How do I install omasnap on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add omasnap. The download is 1.1 MB and it takes 2.4 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is omasnap free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed MIT, OFL-1.1.

How do I uninstall omasnap?

Run omarchy pkg drop omasnap. It removes the package from your system.

What does omasnap depend on?

The package declares 7 dependencies: hyprland, layer-shell-qt, qt6-base, tesseract, tesseract-data-eng, wayland, wl-clipboard. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is omasnap a desktop app?

Yes. Open the launcher with Super + Space and search for omasnap.

Is omasnap in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as omasnap (version 1.24.0-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Omacom makes it. Project site: https://github.com/omacom/omasnap.
